notes:
{小皿|こざら} are small dishes used for serving condiments, sauces, and small portions of food. They are essential in Japanese table settings.

Common uses:
- ⟦{醤油皿|しょうゆざら}→醤油皿：noentry⟧ (for soy sauce)
- ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{皿|ざら}→皿：noentry⟧ (individual serving plate)
- ⟦{薬味|やくみ}→薬味：04964_yakumi⟧⟦{皿|ざら}→皿：noentry⟧ (for condiments like ginger or wasabi)

Size note: {小皿|こざら} are typically 6-12cm in diameter. Slightly larger plates (12-18cm) are called ⟦{中皿|ちゅうざら}→中皿：17754_chuuzara⟧.
